links.outcome: Clinician AI familiarity, practical use, knowledge of limitations, and interest in training
links.effect: 89.9% moderately/very interested in learning about AI; 44.1% of GPs never used AI vs 34.9% of hospital clinicians (p=0.045); 32.6% of GPs understand some benefits but not limitations.
links.quote: Furthermore, 32.6% of GPs admitted that they "understand some benefits but not the limitations."

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of Italian clinicians evaluating AI awareness, practical exposure, and educational/training needs, bearing on human readiness and governance requirements.
